name: build.swapi/star-wars
title: Star Wars API & MCP server (swapi.build)
description: Free Star Wars MCP server (SWAPI): people, films, planets, species, starships, vehicles. No API key.

tools.name: sw_get
tools.description: Gets one Star Wars entity by numeric record id and returns it as a JSON object. Take the id from the end of an entity's url field (from sw_search, sw_list or a relation URL). Ids are record ids, not episode numbers: FILMS id 1 is A New Hope (Episode IV). An unknown id returns a tool error, e.g. 'No films found with id 99'. Pass expand to get related records in the same call, e.g. ["homeworld", "species"]; name only the relations you need; * on a film can pass 50 KB.

expand.description: Optional. Relations to embed, one level deep, under a final "expanded" key: PEOPLE homeworld, films, species, vehicles, starships; FILMS characters, planets, starships, vehicles, species; PLANETS residents, films; SPECIES homeworld, people, films; STARSHIPS and VEHICLES pilots, films; or ["*"] alone for all. Up to 8 names; an unknown name returns a tool error.

id.description: Numeric record id: the last segment of the entity's url field (1 in .../api/people/1).

resource.description: Resource type: PEOPLE, FILMS, PLANETS, SPECIES, STARSHIPS or VEHICLES. Any other value returns a tool error.

tools.name: sw_list
tools.description: Lists every entity of one Star Wars resource type as a JSON array (Episodes I-VI data). Responses are large (all 82 PEOPLE, about 38 KB); to find a single entity, prefer sw_search, then sw_get; for a compact index pass fields, e.g. ["name"] (about 5 KB).

fields.description: Optional. Field names to keep in each entity (url is always kept), e.g. ["name"] (FILMS: ["title"]). Up to 24 names; an unknown name returns a tool error listing the valid ones. Omit for full entities.

resource.description: Resource type: PEOPLE, FILMS, PLANETS, SPECIES, STARSHIPS or VEHICLES. Any other value returns a tool error.

tools.name: sw_random
tools.description: Returns one random Star Wars entity of the given resource type as a JSON object. Each call can return a different entity, so it is not idempotent. Useful for demos and quizzes; to fetch a specific entity use sw_search or sw_get.

resource.description: Resource type: PEOPLE, FILMS, PLANETS, SPECIES, STARSHIPS or VEHICLES. Any other value returns a tool error.

tools.name: sw_search
tools.description: Start here. Finds Star Wars entities by name (title for FILMS) with a case-insensitive substring match: 'sky' finds Luke, Anakin and Shmi Skywalker. Returns a JSON array of full entities; an empty array [] means no match; pass fields to shorten each entity. The id to pass to sw_get is the last segment of each entity's url field. Data covers Episodes I-VI only.

fields.description: Optional. Field names to keep in each entity (url is always kept), e.g. ["name"] (FILMS: ["title"]). Up to 24 names; an unknown name returns a tool error listing the valid ones. Omit for full entities.

resource.description: Resource type: PEOPLE, FILMS, PLANETS, SPECIES, STARSHIPS or VEHICLES. Any other value returns a tool error.
